questions.question: What is the primary purpose of using an electron microprobe analyzer in quantitative X-ray metallography?

answers.a: To measure the hardness of ceramic materials
answers.b: To determine the crystallographic structure of metals
answers.c: To analyze the compositional distribution of elements.
answers.d: To observe the optical properties of materials

questions.question: Which of the following is the most important factor in achieving accurate quantitative compositional analysis using an electron microprobe analyzer?

answers.a: High magnification of the electron beam

questions.question: Which of the following is a limitation of EPMA when analyzing ceramics?

answers.a: Inability to detect elements with high atomic numbers
answers.b: Difficulty in distinguishing between overlapping X-ray peaks from similar elements
answers.c: Limited to analyzing only metallic samples
answers.d: Requires samples to be in powder form

questions.question: Why is it crucial to use standards when performing quantitative compositional measurements of ceramics with an electron microprobe analyser?

answers.a: To compare the crystal structure of different samples
answers.b: To ensure the X-ray intensity is high
answers.c: To accurately determine the concentration of elements by comparing them with known compositions
answers.d: To measure the mechanical properties of the material
